name: gizza-ai/jwt-decode
summary: Decode a JSON Web Token offline without verification

tool.description: Decode a JSON Web Token (JWT) offline to inspect its header, payload claims, signature presence, and validate exp/nbf/iat time claims. No secret/public key is required.

leeway.description: Clock-skew tolerance in seconds applied to exp/nbf/iat checks (default 0).

now.description: Reference time as seconds since the Unix epoch. When omitted (0), the current clock time is used.
